name: 3D logo extrude — assemble
description: Three.js logo sting on a transparent background: an SVG logo (paste markup; a 3-part geometric mark by default) is extruded into glossy 3D, its parts fly in from depth with a stagger and lock together while the lockup turns from a 3/4 view to front-facing, a light bar sweeps a glint across the clearcoat and it holds over a soft floor shadow; use as an intro/outro brand sting or a logo hit over footage (16:9 and 9:16).
